translation_notes: The twelve `bundle.add` of the loop body collapse into seven `+{ }` islands on `@graph bundle`, with `;` for same-subject runs; `RDF.type` is `a`, the OEO/OBO/RDFS terms are prefixed names imported with `from context_shim import oeo:, obo:, …` in place of `from factsheet.oekg.namespaces import …`.

`URIRef("…/publication/" + item["id"])`, `URIRef("…/" + author["iri"])` and `URIRef(item["link_to_study_report"])` are `f<…{item['id']}…>` (no @base in scope, no encoding in either form, so the IRIs are identical).
`Literal(item["date_of_publication"], datatype=XSD.dateTime)` is `f"{item['date_of_publication']}"^^xsd:dateTime`: equal for a string AND for None (lexical form "None"), checked with rdflib 7.2.1.

`Literal(item["doi"])` is KEPT as `{Literal(item["doi"])}` on purpose: the doi arrives as data from the front end and may be None, in which case the original writes the literal "None" whereas a bare `{item["doi"]}` raises TypeError (ldpy 0.7.1). The driver has a publication with `doi: None`, and the mutation `{item["doi"]}` makes the check FAIL. `Literal(item["id"])` and `Literal(remove_non_printable(…))` are bare interpolations: the first is concatenated into an IRI just above (a str or the original raises first), the second is a str by construction.

Context shim: factsheet.* is a Django project, not installed. context_shim.py holds the namespaces, the two helpers, and the loop's free variables (`bundle`, `study_URI`, `_publications`, locals of the enclosing view that the extraction did not capture); the four publications span the branches of the loop.

Credit correction (2026-11-02, corpus/403 defect 3): dropped `dc:, oekg:` from the prefix import, declared by the mechanical draft but never used as a term in the translated region (and not among the bindings the original sets on its graph); `rdfeval check` stays OK.

optimization_notes: optimized.py: runs of bundle.add become `bundle += [...]`; `_authors` is inlined; the double date test is `not in ("01-01-1900", "")`; the last `bundle.add((study_URI, OBO.BFO_0000051, publications_URI))` goes, since the same triple is already added at the top of the loop body.

optimized.ldpy, from optimized.py: each `bundle += [...]` becomes one `+{ }` with `;`/`.`; URIRef("..." + x) is f<...{x}>; Literal(x) a bare {x} except Literal(item["doi"]), kept because doi may be None; the dateTime literal is f"..."^^xsd:dateTime as in the translation.
No exception to the symmetry: author_URI stays (it appears twice in its island and is a module value the driver compares).
